notes.title: Post-Launch Announcement
notes.content:
I want to start by thanking everyone for their support so far. 🐝💜 We are incredibly lucky to have such a wonderful community and we appreciate all of you. Over the last couple of days we have received reports from players about issues preventing progression and other little bugs and we wanted to make sure to take some time to address them. We put out a small patch to fix the most pressing one.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h3]Tracks of Thought_RELEASE_v17.1.5.12[/h3]
[list]
[*] The door to the Diner car [i](car #2)[/i] no longer opens before intended, which caused a myriad of other issues like: [list]
[*] Missing interaction popups
[*] Dialogue not loading in or dialogue trying to run all at once
[*] Dialogue boxes appearing small and far into the distance
[/list]Players can now only access it once they have a personality and rival assigned by finishing the Starry Night car [i](car #1)[/i] storyline. This sadly does require starting a new save file if you've slipped past the first door.
[*] Added a Foreground hide function in the Starry Night car to avoid blocking the view of Patricia during dialogue
[*] Dialogue boxes now show special characters during battles
[*] Adjusted triggerbox for the Window Interactable in the Diner car, so it doesn't intervene with Rory's triggerbox
[*] Lowered dialogue notification position for Baby Bean and Jacob in the Diner car so it doesn’t appear off-screen
[*] Adjusted build name tag from ALPHA to RELEASE
[*] Fixed spelling error [i](straight instead of stiaght)[/i] in the Card scanner's 'Passengers' tab 
[*] Fixed wrong species information in the Card scanner's 'Passengers' tab
[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
There are a few major bugs 🐛 that we have flagged as [i]high priority issues[/i] since they affect or prevent progression in the game. Being a small team, we are working as fast as we can towards a patch to address as many as we can. We are aiming to get a patch released [b]within the next couple of weeks[/b] to fix the high-priority issues at a minimum and hopefully most if not all of the other issues as well. We appreciate your patience and understanding as we work through the rest of this list!

[h3]High Priority:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Saving the game while near Deborah in the Starry Night car [i](car #1)[/i] will cause the Player to get stuck. This corrupts your save file and sadly requires deletion in order to progress the game.
[*] HP bars not updating properly during Battles
[*] If log files are present from a previous Demo playthrough it doesn't load the full game correctly.
[list]
[*] To quickly fix this you can delete the files in the AppData folder before starting a new save file ➜  [i]C:\Users\username\AppData\LocalLow\TidbitsPlay\TracksOfThought[/i]
[/list][/list][h3]Other:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Misaligned interaction when trying to talk to Maple the shopkeeper
[*] Some conversation triggers being out of reach or difficult to trigger
[*] Some conversations not triggering under the right conditions
[*] The 'Passengers' tab does not update > Missing a Tutorial for the Card Scanner.
[/list]
───── ✦•🐞•✦ ─────
If you find any other bugs (that isn’t one of the characters, haha), please hop on over to our [url=https://discord.gg/FpbUMSXNkT]Discord [/url]server to report it so we can add it to the list of issues to get patched as soon as possible!

And of course, be sure to stay on top of all things Tracks by following us on [url=https://twitter.com/tracksofthought]Twitter [/url]and [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCvV4OSCMR_vO0jZ9R74Q64A]YouTube[/url] and joining our [url=https://discord.gg/FpbUMSXNkT]Discord[/url] server. Thank you for everything!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39362627/7a011aff9b0b6e0eeff0fa303eceffa264bac222.png[/img]
- Esmeé and the Tidbits Play team

notes.title: May Dev Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]DEAR PASSENGERS[/b] 🐞📣[/h2]

It’s been a while since we’ve updated y’all on what we’ve been up to! We promise we’re still here and still doing our best. Some of our team members have been struggling with physical health issues, but we’re all okay and health(ier) now!

These months have been filled with so many new things - especially for us developers! We've been working hard on our bug puns, polishing the train cars with fun trinkets and adding some pep in the step of our characters.

[h3]🎁 [b]collectibles[/b] 🛍️[/h3]


We added over 50 items in the game to collect, snack on or use in quests. What do you think these are for?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39362627/3e9715a69cf63003f5c2598c74ae44a5952c211b.png[/img]

Let us know in the comments 👀

[h3]🐕 [b]battle barks[/b] 🐩[/h3]

We updated the Battle Barks in the card battles. This is flavor dialogue where the characters "bark" at you after each turn.

Before these lines were only determined by which card type the opponent HATES or LOVES, but players like you told us this could be a little confusing sometimes. You could technically play a card a bug would HATE but it lets you fill the bar resulting in a battle win.

You would reach "CONSENSUS" but since they hate the card you played, they would still say something like "OH NO :(" 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39362627/aa19e83af8ee2a906a97db15a4ef1d5898ad0a8c.gif[/img]

This is why we made some big improvements to this system and wrote a lot of custom dialogue. Here you see a few actions the characters can respond to in the card battles.

Now the conversation feels a lot more natural and responsive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39362627/7a509a4f7934b3173c21753ff4cc1f09f4497d04.png[/img]

 [h3]🧸[b]say hello! [/b]🧸[/h3]

We’ve also added dialogue with more NPCs!

Make sure to say hello to our lil caterpillar friend, baby Bean!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39362627/ae1ba16ffebc89804ecc8638a4c0e1918a2b77e0.png[/img]

Here’s what a conversation with baby Bean might look like 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39362627/e5261367296c437bd79c98424ee6ade84176957e.png[/img]

───── ✦•🐞•✦ ─────

Thanks so much for your support! If there's anything specific you'd like to see us cover in our dev updates, like characters, mechanics, etc, let us know in the comments! You can also join our [url=https://discord.gg/N5vmBWCZCb]Discord[/url], and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/tracksofthought]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/tracksofthought/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@tracksofthought]TikTok[/url] for more updates. Cya next time :)

Bug out!

The Tracks of Thought Team

notes.title: February Update + Backerkit!
notes.content:
DEAR PASSENGERS 🐞📣

It’s been a while since we’ve updated y’all on what we’ve been up to, so let’s dive right in.

These months have been filled with so many new things - especially for us developers! We’ve been working on a lot of back-end things that sometimes don’t always come across visually, like bug fixes, troubleshooting, and this!

🔟 controller support 🔢

We’ve been working on controller support! We want everyone to be able to play, regardless of what you’re comfortable with. Xbox and Playstation controllers are now compatible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39362627/11d0cebb008204cdcb517d1aab42e0b7235db8b9.png[/img]


You can find all these settings and more in the Settings menu in the final game.

🖼️ accessibility updates 🖼️


Right now, we’re working on some extra accessibility features. Just like with controller support, we want everyone to be able to play, so we’ve added some things like disabling certain visual effects and adding a dyslexia-friendly font as an option!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39362627/3cd1687c4b5119e2887a7c5847fddfd334cb19dd.png[/img]

Here’s our dyslexic-friendly font in action!

🧁 heal system 🧁

We’ve also added a healing system to make sure you maintain your HP! Not only are yummy snacks involved, but so are special cards too! Keep an eye out and let us know which one is your favorite.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39362627/8b344e933c0363d6cb8a737b8a0ec5a2c69af36c.gif[/img]

📣 Backerkit launch 📣

The best announcement is always saved for last > Our [url=https://www.backerkit.com/call_to_action/1951e8cc-4ab6-4330-ad94-11811f927783/landing?ref=c-main-page&utm_source=Steam&utm_medium=Crowdfunding_Post_Steam&utm_campaign=ToT_Crowdfunding]crowdfunding campaign[/url] ends in two weeks! Thank you so much to BackerKit for having us as their first featured video game! 💜 Make sure to check us out to help us get our little bug RPG to the finish line. 

To celebrate, we’re holding a giveaway! Check it out [url=https://gleam.io/fBKFW/tracks-of-thought-backerkit-key-giveaway]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39362627/ad8ad46f549b1a0c1a9602a34234b2ebd09b6f81.png[/img]

Thanks so much for your support! If there's anything specific you'd like to see us cover in our dev updates, like characters, mechanics, etc, let us know in the comments! You can also join our Discord, and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/tracksofthought]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/tracksofthought/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@tracksofthought]TikTok[/url] for more updates. Cya next time :)

Bug out!
- The Tracks of Thought Team

notes.title: New Year? New Updates + Backerkit!
notes.content:
DEAR PASSENGERS 🐞📣

It’s been a while since we’ve updated y’all on what we’ve been up to, so let’s dive right in.

These months have been filled with so many new things - especially for us developers! We’ve been working on a lot of back-end things that sometimes don’t always come across visually, like bug fixes, troubleshooting, and this!

🔟 spreadsheet shenanigans 🔢

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39362627/bb4b9e1c84e41448cfaf1e042c66640cee5c4ecb.gif[/img]

This is a spreadsheet integration we’ve been working on! The integration automatically updates the cards’ text and dialogue. This allows our writer to make quick edits without touching the game engine, making importing assets very easy. 

Now on to things that you as the player can see!

🖼️ GUI updates 🖼️
We’ve updated some of our menus and buttons. Check out our new save select screen! Each card is a different player profile and also keeps track of which personality you were assigned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39362627/d142b5a14d0bf9a4196a56a0e8fd6d6bc719acf8.png[/img]

We’ve added a Journal and Quest log to help you keep track of information! This will also provide a quest overview. These quests can be as simple as retrieving an item or locating a friend, and some will be a little more complex. Solving quests will help the passengers remember their destination, and will get you one step closer to reaching the final train car!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39362627/3322ced70839e0b5f45b00dc458a7a280c884d8d.png[/img]

Right now, the journal is a work in progress, so definitely let us know what you’d like to see in it in the future.

🧁 shop system 🧁

We’ve also added a shop and currency system. These yummy snacks can heal you or give you boosts during card battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39362627/c17097ad9434f385f020d4b676298290508d0669.png[/img]

📣 Backerkit launch 📣

The best announcement is always saved for last > Our crowdfunding pre-launch page is [url=https://www.backerkit.com/call_to_action/1951e8cc-4ab6-4330-ad94-11811f927783/landing?ref=c-main-page]live [/url]RIGHT NOW! Thank you so much to BackerKit for having us as their first featured video game!💜Make sure to check us out and pre-save our page to help us get our little bug RPG to the finish line. 

[url=https://www.backerkit.com/call_to_action/1951e8cc-4ab6-4330-ad94-11811f927783/landing?ref=c-main-page][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39362627/ad8ad46f549b1a0c1a9602a34234b2ebd09b6f81.png[/img][/url]

───── ✦•🐞•✦ ─────

Thx so much for your support! If there's anything specific you'd like to see us cover in our dev updates, like characters, mechanics, etc, let us know in the comments! You can also join our Discord, and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/tracksofthought]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/tracksofthought/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@tracksofthought]TikTok[/url] for more updates. Cya next time :)

Bug out!
- The Tracks of Thought Team
